CHAP USTUN:
9) 'Fill in the question tags and then read the sentences aloud with the correct intonation.' Chap tomonda jadval 'sure / not sure' ustunlari, belgilar: 1 sure - Your mother is a chef, ...? 2 sure - She hasn't got any brothers, ...? 3 not sure - It's going to rain, ...? 4 sure - You have dinner at 8 o'clock, ...? 5 sure - Tom is very clever, ...? 6 not sure - You weren't asleep, ...? 7 sure - She had finished by the time I called, ...? 8 not sure - Bob hasn't called yet, ...? 9 not sure - They found her, ...? 10 sure - Mary can dive, ...? 11 sure - I am late, ...? 12 not sure - You're going to go, ...? 13 not sure - Sue didn't call, ...? 14 sure - Their flat is spacious, ...? 15 not sure - She's been to Cairo, ...?
'Revision: Units 1 - 15' (jigarrang banner):
10) 'Choose the correct answer.' 1 ... they go jogging every day? A Doesn't B Does C Do. 2 She ... the violin at my birthday. A played B play C playing. 3 This is the ... expensive stereo I've ever seen. A much B most C more. 4 ... you been waiting long? A Have B Was C Has. 5 They ... going to buy a boat. A won't B isn't C aren't. 6 Are there ... bananas left? A some B any C much.

O'NG USTUN:
7 I haven't ... tennis for five years. A plays B play C played. 8 He cleaned the carpets after he ... finished his lunch. A had B have C has. 9 This song was ... by Frank Sinatra. A writing B written C write. 10 You ... forget to do your homework. A mustn't B must C should. 11 ... I had a lot of money, I would buy a castle. A While B When C If. 12 She travelled to France ... she took a tour on the Seine. A why B when C where. 13 I would love ... to the beach tomorrow. A go B to go C going. 14 If I ... you, I would study harder. A were B had been C be. 15 Daniel isn't a doctor, ... he? A are B was C is. 16 Carol ... me what happened yesterday. A said B told C tells. 17 ... an amazing story! A What's B What C How. 18 Let's go to the park before it ... dark! A gets B will get C got. 19 He ... to work as a car mechanic. A used B uses C use. 20 I love ... documentaries. A watched B watch C watching. 21 Is the bus station located ... the heart of the city? A on B in C at. 22 Had she ... the laundry? A do B done C doing. 23 The plane has ... taken off. A just B yet C when.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the question tags and then read the sentences aloud with the correct intonation (sure = voice goes down ↘, not sure = voice goes up ↗).
exercises.instructionUz: Ajratilgan savollarni yozing va gaplarni to'g'ri intonatsiya bilan ovoz chiqarib o'qing (sure = ishonch, ovoz pasayadi ↘; not sure = ishonchsiz, ovoz ko'tariladi ↗).
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL + INTONATSIYA.

  ↘ SURE (ishonch): 1, 2, 4, 5, 7,
    10, 11, 14
  ↗ NOT SURE (tekshirish): 3, 6,
    8, 9, 12, 13, 15

  1 is → isn't she? ↘
  2 hasn't got → has she? ↘
  3 's going → isn't it? ↗
  4 have dinner → don't you? ↘
    (have = yemoq → do)
  5 is → isn't he? ↘
  6 weren't → were you? ↗
  7 had finished → hadn't she? ↘
  8 hasn't → has he? ↗
  9 found → didn't they? ↗
  10 can → can't she? ↘
  11 I am → aren't I? ↘
  12 're going → aren't you? ↗
  13 didn't → did she? ↗
  14 is → isn't it? ↘
  15 's been → hasn't she? ↗


⚠ 'SPACIOUS':

  = keng.

items.textEn: (sure ↘) She had finished by the time I called, ___?

exercises.explanationUz:
1-15 UNITLAR TAKRORI.

  1 DO they go (they)
  2 She PLAYED (o'tgan)
  3 the MOST expensive
  4 HAVE you been waiting
  5 They AREN'T going
  6 Are there ANY (savol)
  7 haven't PLAYED (V3)
  8 after he HAD finished
  9 was WRITTEN (passiv)
  10 You MUSTN'T forget (taqiq)
  11 IF I had (2-tur shart)
  12 France WHERE (joy)
  13 would love TO GO
  14 If I WERE you
  15 isn't a doctor, IS he
  16 Carol TOLD me
  17 WHAT an amazing story
  18 before it GETS dark
  19 He USED to work
  20 love WATCHING
  21 IN the heart of
  22 Had she DONE (past perfect)
  23 has JUST taken off


⚠ 'TAKE OFF':

  = (samolyot) uchib ketmoq.

items.textEn: She ___ the violin at my birthday.
This is the ___ expensive stereo I've ever seen.
They ___ going to buy a boat.
I haven't ___ tennis for five years.
He cleaned the carpets after he ___ finished his lunch.
This song was ___ by Frank Sinatra.
You ___ forget to do your homework.
___ I had a lot of money, I would buy a castle.
She travelled to France ___ she took a tour on the Seine.
I would love ___ to the beach tomorrow.
If I ___ you, I would study harder.
Let's go to the park before it ___ dark!
He ___ to work as a car mechanic.
Is the bus station located ___ the heart of the city?
items.whyUz: ⚠ in the heart of the city.

patterns.exampleEn: Your mother is a chef, isn't she? ↘ It's going to rain, isn't it? ↗
patterns.exampleUz: Onangiz oshpaz, shundaymi? ↘ Yomg'ir yog'adi, shundaymi? ↗

patterns.exampleEn: You have dinner at 8 o'clock, don't you?
patterns.exampleUz: Siz soat 8 da kechki ovqat yeysiz, shundaymi?

patterns.formula: If I were you, I would + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: If I were you, I would study harder.
